requirements_and_performance.name: approved chamber-pressure and mixture-ratio candidate set
burn duration, duty cycle, and performance margins
CEA/RPA case files with explicit station and geometry mapping
requirements_and_performance.evidence_required: reproducible run records and software versions

cooling.name: exact coolant composition and inlet thermodynamic state
validated exact-IPA property provider
cooling.evidence_required: p,T and p,h, transport, saturation, ranges, uncertainty and license

cooling.name: gas-side radiation input or justified model scope
wall material conductivity and temperature limits
cooling.evidence_required: temperature-dependent source, lot/process applicability and allowable definition

cooling.name: boiling, phase-change and wall-state acceptance criteria

supply.name: tank/source pressure and temperature versus time
supply.evidence_required: facility model or measured envelope with uncertainty

supply.name: line, valve, regulator, injector and cooling-path loss data
supply.unit_requirement: geometry or loss coefficient with ranges

supply.name: required propellant/coolant flow and pressure boundary
supply.evidence_required: candidate-specific mass balance and boundary mode

supply.name: transient exclusions and test monitoring limits
supply.evidence_required: PDR-approved handling of startup, shutdown and regulator dynamics

structural.name: pressure and temperature load cases
structural.evidence_required: versioned load definition linked to thermal result

structural.name: temperature-dependent material properties and allowables
structural.evidence_required: material condition, manufacturing process, source and acceptance rule

structural.name: load-bearing geometry, joints, constraints and minimum thickness
approved structural margin or factor policy
structural.evidence_required: team/competition requirement; not assumed by software

combustion_stability.name: injector geometry and pressure-drop evidence
combustion_stability.evidence_required: versioned injector definition and test/model source

combustion_stability.name: feed-system and chamber acoustic/dynamic evidence
combustion_stability.evidence_required: separate dynamic analysis or relevant test

combustion_stability.name: ignition, startup and shutdown stability evidence
combustion_stability.evidence_required: test plan or validated transient model

combustion_stability.name: combustion-stability acceptance criteria
combustion_stability.evidence_required: approved source; CEA/RPA steady performance is insufficient

cad_handoff.name: parameter status and selection reason per CAD-driving value
cad_handoff.evidence_required: source, model, assumption and change trigger
